info.headline: Boil water advisory for the city of Bloomington
info.description: A water main break may contaminate the supply. Boil water before drinking.

info.headline: State Route 46 closed at Smith Pike due to flooding
info.description: Motorists are asked to avoid the area.

info.headline: Evacuate the riverfront neighbourhood now
info.description: Rising water threatens the homes along the river. Move to higher ground.
